posts.caption:
The news is finally out! I am so happy to announce I’ll be riding for the PHR Triumph Team, in the Pirelli National Sportbike Championship for 2025. 
-
I’d like to Thank Peter Hickman for a fantastic opportunity to prove myself on a strong package in Sportbike for next season! I can’t wait to spin some more laps on the Triumph and get the BSB season underway soon 👀. 
-
My goals for 2025 are to run at the front each weekend, competing for consistent podiums and race wins. With being apart of such a strong project, I believe the PHR team and I are more than capable of achieving this goal, and man I can’t wait to add some more trophies to the cabinet 😋. 
-
A big shoutout to Chris Parker from Two Tyres, Fletchers Solicitors, Arcon Gloves, VMoto scooters for playing a massive part for coming onboard as my sponsors for previous years  and into 2025 💪🏻.
Been fortunate to have someone work on a new logo for me. Thank you. Exciting news to share with you all soon
